entry: Run set up for Glymph 0.4.0rc1 (frozen by run 20261118-1245_glymph-040-dev: clusters from principal components, tree that only protects, swapped fraction from gene contrast below 5% depth-proportional background, false-positive allowance 0.3%). Two passes over 54 libraries; CellBender 0.4.0, Glymph 0.3.2, scAR, SoupX and DecontX outputs linked from the earlier runs and scored again with the current scoring script.

Both passes done (54 of 54 libraries each). The five kidney libraries failed in scoring because the run's data link pointed at the shared data folder and not at the folder with the kidney authors' metadata; link corrected and the five tasks resubmitted (59827533, collection 59827534). submit_bench_040rc1.sh corrected.

Mixtures, 0.4.0rc1 against CellBender 0.4.0 (Glymph 0.3.2 in brackets). The 12 mixtures never used in development: cross-species removal 88.6% (85.7%) against 83.4%; same-species removal 1.01 of the amount measured inside cells (0.97) against 0.83; per-cell error against the measured truth 0.0193 (0.0201) against 0.0465, against the benchmark's extrapolation 0.0170 (0.0159) against 0.0433; rank agreement 0.69 (0.65) against 0.55. Two runs differ by 0.01 points of removal (0.3.2: 2.7). By platform, all libraries of the tier: 10x cell lines 93.7% against 91.5%; xenografts 81.4% against 69.4%; BD Rhapsody 92.9% against 92.6%; Parse 80.2% against 62.3%; nuclei mixture 79.5% against 32.3%. Over all 27 mixtures: higher removal on 18, lower per-cell error on 27 (measured truth; 26 by the extrapolation), higher rank agreement on 24. scAR removes more (92.0% on the held-out mixtures) with 5 times the measured same-species background removed and counts added.

Two faults of 0.4.0rc1 found in this run. (1) xeno_noHSC_2 (held out): 139 cells lose more than 10% of their counts and more than three times their true background plus 3 points (0.3.2: 7; CellBender 425); the library has 3.4% of its counts removed where the truth is 1.9% (2.6% measured). Over the 27 mixtures the count is 143 cells of 164,497 (0.3.2: 9; CellBender 4,206; scAR 9,704; 83 against the measured truth). The 15 development mixtures showed 3 against 1, so development did not see it. (2) bd_demo_pbmc (looked at before, not part of the development rounds): 17.1% of the counts removed (0.3.2: 5.4%; CellBender 2.0%, SoupX 1.8%, DecontX 5.6%) with a background of 17% of depth, the ambient multiplier at its lower bound and 27% of the called cells set aside as doublet-like. A fit that runs away: all three starting clusterings end at 936 to 1,029 background counts at the median depth, where 0.3.2 had 200, 208 and 895 and kept the middle one. Also: xeno_HSC_2 (held out) has no silent-gene estimate in either version and 64% of its cross-species counts removed against CellBender's 78%.

Consequence: 0.4.0rc1 is not the version to stand on. The runaway on bd_demo_pbmc is taken back to the development run (round M7: the tested pairs are settled before the fit). Nothing is tuned on the held-out libraries; xeno_noHSC_2 and xeno_HSC_2 are reported as they came out.

Kidney libraries scored (five, genotype truth; all were development libraries). 0.4.0rc1 against CellBender 0.4.0 (Glymph 0.3.2 in brackets): per-cell error 0.0899 (0.0892) against 0.0971; rank agreement 0.382 (0.377) against 0.368; removed over truth 1.05 (0.99) against 0.96; tubule markers removed from other cell types 88.1% (85.9%) against 83.1%; kept in tubule cells 87.8% (87.9%) against 86.7%. Level with CellBender within what the libraries can tell: lower error on four of five, by 0.002 to 0.027. Not the large margin of the mixtures.

Tissue libraries without truth (22): share of counts removed 5.5% on average (0.3.2: 7.1%; CellBender 9.0%, which removes 60 to 63% on the two BD PBMC donor libraries and keeps none of one library's markers); markers kept in their own group 98.9% (98.8%; CellBender 95.0% with that failure, 99.7% without it); markers removed from the other groups 18.5% (20.7%; CellBender 12.9%). Glymph's outputs are integers that never exceed the raw counts on all 54 libraries; scAR, SoupX and DecontX break that on every library.

Resources: median 101 s per library (0.3.2: 98 s; CellBender 2,135 s), 1.88 GPU-hours for one pass over the 54 libraries against 34.5, 3.5 GB of RAM and 7.0 GB of GPU memory at the median. The calibration additions cost nothing measurable.
